briefings.headline: Brent is trading near $91 as a 5.28 million barrel API crude build outweighs a new ADNOC vessel attack in Hormuz and US-Iran strikes across the Gulf, so today's EIA report and the Trump-Xi-Putin summit are the next tests.

Brent has slid to about $91.7 as surplus expectations outweigh a fresh run of Hormuz tanker attacks, so the next 24 hours turn on whether Iran's two-day reopening plan gains traction or the attacks begin to cut physical flows.
